generation_method: Built-in image_gen__imagegen, transparent_background=true; one initial generation and one targeted edit per wordmark. Originals retained under CODEX_HOME/generated_images.
design: Original angular rhythm-game lettering; no Patapon characters or copied wordmarks. COMBO digits are drawn dynamically by the game.

assets.initial_prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: transparent rhythm game UI wordmark. Create ONE original exuberant hand-lettered wordmark with ONLY the exact text "FEVER!!" (F E V E R, then exactly two exclamation marks). Bright orange-red and golden yellow chunky angular letters, uneven lively rhythm, sharp comic cut-ins and tiny flame-like letter tips. Thick dark espresso outline plus thin warm cream outer outline, clean hard edges and flat colors compatible with a crafted pixel game. No glossy 3D, no mascots. Horizontal compact word silhouette approximately 3.5:1 width:height, minimal safe transparent padding on all sides. Must remain very legible at 260x80. No numerals, other lettering, background, scene or decorative objects. TRUE transparent alpha background. Single isolated wordmark only.
assets.edit_prompt: Edit this FEVER!! wordmark only. Preserve exact text FEVER!!, colors, letter identities and thick dark/cream outlines. Make the letter shapes a little shorter and wider so the painted wordmark itself is 3.5:1 width:height. IMPORTANT fit the entire wordmark safely inside a transparent 3:1 canvas, leaving at least 50 pixels transparent padding around every outer point, no clipped outlines. Remove disconnected tiny specks outside the lettering; clean crisp flat graphic edges. No additional text, scene, numbers or objects. True transparent alpha background.
assets.processing: Lossless rectangular alpha-aware crop only, preserving generated alpha; 18px padding around alpha>127 content.
